description: The webview's entire ACL grant. The frontend reaches Rust only two ways: invoking this app's own #[tauri::command]s, never gated by the capability system, and listen with its returned unlisten in src/lib/liveClient.ts, so event listen and unlisten is the whole grant. Every window operation goes through custom commands, so no core:window permission is needed, and core:default's menu, tray, app, and path grants are equally unused.
